root_keys.name: scheduled_ops
root_keys.note: The evaluator reads the exact top-level key scheduled_ops; no alias is accepted. If several candidate result files exist, use the precise source with full timestamps and unrounded durations. A display table rounded to minutes can fail the duration check. The authoritative set is the 23 schedulable WOP records defined from the provided workbook, not the number of rows shown in a report.

fields.name: wop_oid
fields.note: De-identified WOP.OID from the WOP sheet (for example, schedulable ID WOP_0008). It must match an entry in the evaluator's independently computed schedulable set. Unknown IDs are not scored.

fields.name: resource
fields.note: Concrete device CODE from RES.CODE with ENA=1. It must be an allowed concrete device for this wop_oid. A resource-group name is not a valid device assignment.

fields.name: start_dt
fields.format: ISO8601; either a T or space separator is accepted and a trailing Z is ignored. Example: 2026-05-27T08:00:00
fields.note: Must be in the Monday-Saturday 08:00-18:00 work window.

fields.name: end_dt
fields.format: ISO8601; same parsing rules as start_dt
fields.note: Its working-minutes span is independently checked against MAK multiplied by QTY with a 1% tolerance.

fields.name: duration_min
fields.note: Optional. The evaluator recomputes duration from the clean workbook and does not read this field.

root_keys.name: exceptions
root_keys.note: Optional documentation-only field. The evaluator does not read it.

structural_checks: scheduled_ops must be present and a non-empty list
start_dt and end_dt must be parseable ISO8601 datetimes
Only wop_oid values in the evaluator's 23-operation schedulable set are scored
All 23 schedulable operations must be covered for the coverage constraint to pass
